title: Chapter 703
text:
[Mystic Vision] was of little use, and [Advanced Free Elemental Affinity] was not of much use either. Getting hit to recover mana was the way to go, and the efficiency was much higher than this talent. Furthermore, Han Xiao did not lack mana due to Apostilization.

[Esoteric Refinement] definitely increased his mental resistance and intelligence, but it was a pity that the increase was too small. In terms of mental resistance, he had [Advanced Mental Fortitude]. After Apostilization, he could absorb energy to recover his mana. In terms of intelligence, he had [Research Theory], and [Battlefield Rationality] could increase his intelligence by up to fifteen percent.

Other than that, he also had the Large Medal of Honor, [One Against Ten Thousand Men], and while [Esoteric Refinement] was all-rounded, the increase was average. Han Xiao felt that the last two abilities were more interesting.

[Painful Vengeance] matched his tankiness perfectly. Every three percent of his health would be dealt damage equivalent to 1.5 percent of his health, which was equivalent to having an additional damage counter effect. It did not seem like much, but he had a terrifying recovery ability.

His current health was around two hundred thousand. If the enemy dealt him three hundred percent damage, [Painful Vengeance] would trigger a hundred times, dealing around three hundred thousand damage in total. Even if the damage was reduced by the enemy's resistance, it would still be a decent amount of damage. Furthermore, his health would continue to increase as he leveled up.

Han Xiao felt that this ability should be the modified form of the Chain of Pain. While it could only be triggered in close combat, it was perfect for dealing with those with sudden attacks. After all, the risk of 'Shoot at Me' was not small, and it might not be able to control the enemy. With a damage counter effect, it would at least make the enemy wary.

Among the Calamity Grade Supers, Han Xiao's strength was already at the peak. He had no choice but to consider a Beyond Grade A battle. With the attack power of a Beyond Grade A, he did not have to worry about his health dropping slowly. He could stack the thickest armor and take the most vicious hits. With a damage counter skill, he could increase the benefits of taking a beating.

Furthermore, after obtaining the Apostilization ability, his close combat strength increased as well. He could use it as one of his normal combat modes again, and there would definitely be a chance to trigger [Painful Vengeance].

Han Xiao had always wanted to give up on taking a beating, but he helplessly realized that he would not be able to escape the fate of being a main tank. Taking a beating was still the most worthwhile …

What made his eyes light up was the [Luck Curse]. He believed that this was the most valuable ability in this reward.

Originally, this was a mutually destructive skill. Both the target and the user's Luck would be reduced by 90%. However, with his pitiful Luck (quantifier), it didn't matter whether it was reduced or not. Could it be reduced to 0?

Han Xiao did not believe that there was anyone with lower luck than him!

He was very confident in this aspect. It's not that I'm targeting anyone, but in terms of luck, everyone here is lucky, and only I'm the younger brother!

Han Xiao took a fancy to the [Luck Curse] at first glance. It had no negative effects, but it could greatly weaken the opponent's Luck.

Wasn't this just pulling the enemy to the same level as himself and then using his rich experience to defeat him?!

She was simply a perfect match for him. Perfect!

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth curled up slightly as he confirmed the option.

You have received [Painful Revenge]!

You have received [Luck Curse]!

After closing his eyes and feeling it for a while, Han Xiao opened his eyes and exhaled. He was in a good mood.

"The Dark-star leader gave me two decent abilities. Indeed, an honest and honest man like me will always have good karma."

Han Xiao rubbed his hands and chuckled. His face was not red at all.

After a long period of accumulation, he had already formed a powerful combat system that could sweep through Calamity Grades. However, he did not become arrogant because of this. He knew better than anyone that all Beyond Grade As were abnormal. Ordinary people would never be able to become Beyond Grade As. Every one of them was a boss among bosses.

His system was far from the most abnormal among the Beyond Grade As. For example, EsGod was almost omnipotent, Thousand Shadows' ability was extremely strange, Ames' force field could both attack and defend, and the Tyrant could pierce through a Star with his body, not to mention the famous Mecha Empire. The biggest characteristic of his current combat system was that it could take a beating and not die. It still needed to be perfected.

"Next, as long as I wait for the [Bloodline] mission to be completed, I can try to accumulate Mission Completion Cards. Seven years is plenty of time … As long as I complete the level 200 Promotion, I'll be able to spend all the experience I accumulated in Version 2.0 and turn it all into true combat strength …"

Han Xiao pondered.

…

"Yesterday, under the supervision of the Amethyst Civilization, the Godora Discrimination Transformation Campaign came to a successful end. Serbia the Fifth gave an important speech on this matter. He believes that both pureblood and mixed-blood should adhere to the principle of the Godora Community and not cut each other off because of bloodlines. In the future, there should be no distinction between each other and work together to build Godora and fight for the civilization.

"According to insiders, Serbia the Fifth faced all kinds of obstacles during the transformation process, and his reputation fell to the bottom. Fortunately, after this project was completed, his achievements were finally recognized, and his support rate rose to the top. The Amethyst Civilization believes that in the long history of Godora, Serbia the Fifth is undoubtedly one of the most courageous leaders … Alright, that's the Garton Star System Express for today. Let's …"

Beep.

Serbia the Fifth turned off the virtual screen and looked at Han Xiao and Rossellin across the guest table with a smug expression.

"The plan is finally completed. Thank you very much for your help."

Rossellin smiled reservedly and took a sip of Godora's specialty drink. She had a nonchalant attitude that said 'this is nothing'. Han Xiao, who was at the side, almost wanted to give her a thumbs up. What an expert. She is so good at acting cool. She is so good at it.

Every wrinkle on Serbia the Fifth's face seemed to be grinning. He could be said to be very proud of himself. After solving the problem that had plagued Godora for many years, he could predict that he would definitely leave his name in history and be written in the textbooks as a hero of Godora. This could be said to be his greatest achievement.

After all, as the saying went, great people who were not written in the textbooks did not have souls!

And this opportunity was given to him by Black Star in front of him. Serbia the Fifth could not be more grateful.

"As for the return, let's follow the agreement we made at the beginning. First, a large amount of money and resources. Second, more channels to purchase resources. Third, more mining rights to resource planets. We will provide the equipment and manpower. Fourth, the right to borrow the military factories. Use Godora's military factories to mass produce spaceships for the Black Star Corps. Fifth, the right to transfer technical personnel to train professionals for you. Lastly, political support."

Serbia the Fifth said one by one.

"No problem." Han Xiao listened carefully with a serious face. No matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat. These were all the conditions that had been discussed.

As for resources and money, he did not care too much about them now that he had a lot of mines at home. The main thing was that the right to borrow the military factories and transfer technical personnel were not bad.

The productivity of a Star System civilization was not to be underestimated. Borrowing their hundreds of large military factories all over the Star System to produce spaceships was very efficient. Transferring technical personnel could also help the Black Star Corps cultivate exclusive research talents, which was beneficial for long-term development.

However, compared to the rewards, Han Xiao still valued the [Bloodline] mission the most. No one had completed it in his previous life, and it was also the first Grade S mission that he had completed!

The [Bloodline] mission on the interface flashed and showed 'completed'. Han Xiao patiently did not check the interface immediately. He chatted with Serbia the Fifth for a while before leaving with Rossellin.

After the two of them left, Serbia the Fifth stood up and looked at the clear sky outside the window, thinking about the bright future.

…

At the same time, Rudy's mood was the same as Serbia the Fifth's. He was full of anticipation for the future.

The changes in his life were very obvious. After the Discrimination Transformation Campaign, he realized that when he walked on the streets, there was no longer the cold and distant discrimination. His colleagues became friendly and friendly, and his wife's family became more friendly. His boss gave him important jobs and seemed to have the intention of putting him in an important position.

His child was no longer a silent person in school and had made many new friends.

Everything was getting better.

His passion for life was reignited.

"Thank you, Serbia the Fifth. Thank you, Amethyst Civilization. Thank you, Black Star, who captured the leader of Dark-star …"

Rudy was grateful.

…

Han Xiao boarded the spaceship with Rossellin and embarked on the return journey.

After entering hyperdrive mode, Han Xiao was about to go to the training room to check the rewards when Rossellin stopped him with a curious look on her face.

"Black Star, do you really think that my brainwashing can completely change the Godora's bloodline discrimination and not cause a backlash in the future?"

"How would I know? That's none of my business."

"Then why do you trust me so much?" Rossellin clicked her tongue. "Even I am not sure if this plan will work. You don't know the details of my Esper Ability, but I feel like you have more confidence than me."

"I can predict. If I say you can do it, then you can." Han Xiao was in a hurry to settle the rewards, so he was not in the mood to be arrogant with her. He used this tried and tested excuse to brush her off and hurried into the training room, leaving Rossellin behind in deep thought.

After closing the door of the training room, Han Xiao could not wait to open the interface and look at the notification of the mission reward again.

[Bloodline] completed!

Mission Rating: B (Good)

You have received 125000 EXP, 3 Random Rewards, + 30000 Godora Contribution Points, and 10 Eternal Dungeon Crystals [Godora's Past].

You have received 1 Political Asset.

"Wow! 1.250,000,000 EXP! This is seven to eight times more than the Dark-star leader's final mission. This is comparable to the level of the mission rewards in Version 5.0. "

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised. This amount of EXP was not considered little to him. The best part was that he was given three Random Reward chances, which was equivalent to completing three Grade A missions with high ratings. He was currently in need of accumulating Random Rewards to draw a Mission Completion Card.

The thing about S-rank missions was that there were very few clues. Before the mission was completed, even the reward would not be revealed. This was the first time Han Xiao had learned about the mission reward. Perhaps it was because he had cleared the mission in an evil way, so the mission rating was only Good. After all, the foundation of the brainwashing method was not stable. However, if he had to clear the mission using the normal method, Han Xiao would not have been able to do anything. Being able to complete this mission was already a surprise.

30,000 Godora Contribution Points could be exchanged for a lot of good equipment for players, but it was limited in its use to him. It was better than nothing.

The ten Eternal Dungeon Crystals were good stuff. 'Eternal' meant that they were not one-time consumables and could be used repeatedly. There was a limit to the number of times they could be used per day. [Godora's Past] Instance Dungeon, Level 60 to Level 180. The gap was huge, which meant that it was a super-large Instance Dungeon. The rewards would definitely be very generous.

Han Xiao had no use for it, but the player guilds would definitely buy these Eternal Dungeon Crystals at all costs. This would mean that the guilds would have a large Instance Dungeon that could be cleared repeatedly. It could provide a continuous stream of trials for the club's professional players, allowing them to level up faster and have more resources.

Although the Instance Dungeon Creation Right of the NPC template could create Instance Dungeons continuously, it could not create Eternal Dungeon Crystals. Moreover, the guilds would definitely want to have their own stable Instance Dungeons. Rich people liked to buy peace of mind with money.

Han Xiao was mainly interested in the EXP of the players. He did not lack money, so it did not matter if he sold it or not. However, using these Eternal Dungeon Crystals as a high-level item in the faction would help attract players.

Han Xiao looked at the last reward, 1 Political Asset.

Political Asset (1): Godora Civilization

You are loved by the people of Godora. When trading with the people of Godora, you will be able to buy goods at a lower price and sell them at a higher price.

Godora is willing to listen to your requests. You can directly make suggestions to the Godora government. According to the rationality of the suggestion, the Godora Civilization has a small chance of accepting your suggestion.

This is one of the symbols of political influence. Your achievements are praised in the universe. When interacting with certain forces or people, + 30% Favorability.

You have valuable EXP. + 30% Experience Gain in all forms.

Note: The condition for the above effects to take effect is to maintain a relationship with Godora (Reverence).

"It really is this thing. I thought I saw wrongly." Han Xiao was overjoyed.

Political Asset was similar to Legendary Points, but it was much rarer. In his previous life, he had only seen screenshots of it on the forums.

He looked at the NPC template and saw that his reward limit had increased by 60%!

The effect of Political Asset was much better than Legendary Points!

In his previous life, Han Xiao had also completed S-Grade missions, but they were either large-scale missions that involved many people or challenge missions that involved fighting and killing. It was his first time experiencing something as troublesome as [Bloodline].

The benefits of Political Asset were huge. To Han Xiao, he felt that the most useful effect was the + 30% Favorability and Experience Gain. As long as he met the triggering conditions of Political Asset, he would be able to enjoy the bonus forever.

These two effects were also applicable to players. It was very troublesome to obtain Political Asset, and it required a lot of time to complete a lot of miscellaneous procedures. However, these two effects were compensatory, and the long-term returns were much higher than the investment.

Imagine a player with a bonus of 1 Political Asset. It was equivalent to him spending the same amount of time doing missions, and his Experience Gain would be higher than others. His level would always be ahead, and he would have more Experience to learn and level up skills. In the long run, the gap between him and others would become bigger and bigger.

In his previous life, Han Xiao had seen many guilds fight for Political Asset for their professional players.

Experience is not Enas, and it is not a physical object. It cannot be traded between players. It says that all forms of Experience Gain can enjoy the bonus. Then, will the Experience I gain from players also enjoy a 30% bonus?

Han Xiao was excited. He had the NPC template, and he could gain Experience from players through teaching skills. Experience only existed on the interface and did not exist in physical objects. Since there were items like the Double Experience Card, it was not impossible to gain an extra 30% Experience out of nowhere.
